text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, Daiwa Scarlet and I go to
watch a race
for field research.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
What an amazing race! There's a lot to
learn from
watching the real thing once
in a while.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One of the racers who lost wraps her
arms around
herself and sobs.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry. I'm sorry... I... I...

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
...No need to apologize. You did great.
You'll get
'em next time.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
You don't get it, Trainer... You gave me
this
wonderful signature racewear, and
I...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I failed! I couldn't run well enough to be
worthy of
these clothes!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Let's go, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daiwa Scarlet leaves in a hurry, so I
scramble to
follow her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daiwa Scarlet stays silent the entire way
back.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I understand how she feels.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I love my signature racewear too.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Just putting it on fills me with energy.
It's my
number one outfit to wear.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Maybe that's why... I'm all too aware of
how she
feels.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
The way she apologized to her signature

racewear... I get it.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
And for a second—just a second—I felt
scared.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Scared that someday, I might be the one
letting
my signature racewear down...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Scared that someday, I might be the one
letting
my signature racewear down...
choice_data_list: That just shows how much you love ...
That just shows how much you love ...
What matters is how you carry your...
What matters is how you carry your...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I do. I really do. That's why I need
to live
up to the expectations that come
with it.
choice_data_list: That just shows how much you love ...
That just shows how much you love ...
What matters is how you carry your...
What matters is how you carry your...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
When I step onto the track, I want to
wear it the
best I can.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I think...
choice_data_list: Then how do you feel about who you...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...I think,
if I'm going to wear the number
one
racewear, I've got to be my number
one self.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
And if I'm still cowering over the thought
of
losing, like I am now...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Then no, I'm not there yet. I'm still not
who I want
to be...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
All right!
I feel like the fog has lifted. No
more
moping around!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Thanks, Trainer. I'm more determined
than ever
to be number one.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Along with my signature racewear, that
is!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The sparkle returns to Daiwa Scarlet's
eyes. It
seems like she's renewed her
resolve.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Stay true to myself, huh...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
You're right. If I'm getting this worried
before I
even start running, I've already
lost.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
If I really am number one—and I am—I'll
make my
outfit reflect that, no problem.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
That's right.
I don't have time to get cold
feet or
mope around feeling sorry for
myself.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
All right! I feel like the fog has lifted.
It's time to
focus on the present rather than
worry about the
future!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Trainer. I'll make sure I become
number
one—in the way that only I can.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Along with my signature racewear, that
is!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The sparkle returns to Daiwa Scarlet's
eyes. It
seems like she's renewed her
resolve.
